replacement_asset.source: Original fixed-size zero-filled replacement emitted by font-source.c; no Darkrose font glyphs are included.

evidence_class: Author-attested Mooneye hardware results as stated in each source header, executed here on the CGB-CPU-E profile in compat mode (header $143 bit 7 clear). boot_div-cgbABCDE claims CGB A-E only. No CGB-E-alone claim, no AGB claim, never game compatibility. Two rows are expected-unsupported until Phase 14.

fixtures.note: Mooneye source header: pass on CGB. Compares the compat-mode post-boot register row.
build_recipe: fetch Mooneye suite revision 31510e12eea6286d36eea060a6adde755e1067aa and verify tree 2b8c52424a49a2a7466cf631fd8992c53d0de2fa
generate the pinned 2032-byte zero replacement asset from ../mooneye/font-source.c
apply the parent headless report patch ../mooneye/headless-report.patch (SHA-256 c3679ab53b59da14a0f6af1fdd552316ba922762c3a91988f7f8ac4440516e5d) with patch --batch --fuzz=0 -p1
assemble misc/boot_regs-cgb.s with wla-gb -I common using the WLA-DX revision pinned by ../mooneye/manifest.json
link with wlalink -nS -d -S; -nS preserves source section order
reproduce with tests/scripts/reproduce-mooneye-cgb.sh --compare fixtures/mooneye-cgb
